faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the questions on your mind.

delivery.question: When will SEO results be visible?
delivery.answer: Initial technical improvements start showing within 1-2 months. Meaningful traffic growth typically takes 3-6 months. SEO is a long-term investment.

pricing.question: How much does SEO cost?
pricing.answer: Varies by site size, industry competition and required scope. We work on a monthly retainer model.

revisions.question: What is the minimum contract length?
revisions.answer: By the nature of SEO, we work with a minimum 6-month agreement. Sufficient time is needed for guaranteed results.

maintenance.question: Who makes the technical SEO changes?
maintenance.answer: We make small technical changes ourselves. For larger development changes, we work in coordination with your dev team.

migration.question: Will SEO value be lost during a site migration?
migration.answer: Not with proper planning. We manage the technical transition in a way that preserves all your SEO value.

mobile.question: Can I run paid ads alongside SEO?
mobile.answer: Absolutely. SEO and paid ads complement each other. As organic traffic grows, your dependency on ads decreases.
